coordinate_system: Y-up, -Z forward; one exported unit is one meter

integration.title: Maritime Fuel Equipment Integration
integration.summary: Two 10 L can variants, a 20 L standalone motor, and a two-handed sky-can catching pole. Geometry and sockets are supplied; gameplay logic and physics belong in the game.
integration.placement: Each file has one root at its floor contact/butt end, recentered to zero. Source units are meters. Pole length is approximately 1.94 m; cans are approximately 0.55 m tall.

nodes.name: JerryCan_Red / JerryCan_Teal
nodes.role: Independent can roots. Each has _Cap, _Grip, _Catch, and _Pour children prefixed with its root name.

nodes.name: FuelMotor_Refill
nodes.role: Target at the open fuel inlet; local +Z points out of the tank in Blender.

nodes.name: FuelMotor_CapHinge
nodes.role: Open pose is authored zero; rotate local X +90 degrees to close. Parent of FuelMotor_Cap.

nodes.name: CanCatcher_MainGrip / CanCatcher_SupportGrip
nodes.role: Hand placement points at 0.20 m and 0.70 m along the shaft. Attach the player hand to MainGrip using its inverse local transform.

nodes.name: CanCatcher_Catch
nodes.role: Trigger/attachment point inside hook. Align a falling can's _Catch point here while keeping the can upright.

setup_steps: Import each file as a separate prefab, preserving named empty sockets and mesh hierarchy; no character rig or animation clips are supplied.
Use one rigidbody per can. Add a small catch trigger near its handle; use swept collision/continuous collision detection for fast falling cans.
When a falling can enters the hook trigger, align its _Catch socket to CanCatcher_Catch, disable its free-fall physics and attach it. Hold at most one can; detach and restore physics on release.
For refuelling, remove the can cap along source +Z and keep the motor cap open. Align the _Pour point over FuelMotor_Refill, with the can tilted so the spout points into the tank.

Transfer fuel only while in range, pouring, and open: amount = min(rate * dt, canFuel, motorCapacity - motorFuel). Subtract and add the same amount. Clamp both reservoirs and prevent duplicate transfer calls.
Motor begins empty. Hide FuelMotor_EmptyPlate and FuelMotor_EmptyText after fuel is added; enable your motor effects only while fuel remains. The motor has no external driven machinery.
Socket positions survive coordinate conversion; source +Z normally maps to engine +Y. Inspect local axes before applying cap rotations or a first-person hand pose.
integration.collision: Use boxes for can shells and motor body, capsules for pole shaft and hook segments, and separate small triggers for catch/refill. Avoid one convex hull over the hook opening. Do not give decorative ribs or labels colliders.

examples.title: Bounded fuel transfer
examples.code:
if pouring and caps_open and spout_in_range:
    amount = max(0, min(rate * dt, can.fuel, motor.capacity - motor.fuel))
    can.fuel -= amount
    motor.fuel += amount

bundles.description: Red fuel can with removable cap and grip, catch, and pour sockets.
Teal fuel can with removable cap and grip, catch, and pour sockets.
Standalone twin-cylinder motor with open fuel inlet and hinged cap.
Player-wielded catching pole with two grip sockets and an upward-opening hook.
